method: read-only file inspection and nvidia-smi; no Isaac run by this preflight

frozen_usd.static_usd_inspection: physics geometry embedded; no sublayers/references/payloads; external OmniPBR.mdl visual material identity remains UNKNOWN; see prior_usd_inspection; no claim of runtime PhysX equivalence

get_measured_joint_efforts.meaning: solver-measured joint force projected along DOF motion; revolute DOF entries are torque, not a separately measured external torque

get_measured_joint_forces.meaning: incoming reaction force and torque per link; shape (num_joints+1,6), row 0 base, rows for joint metadata index+1; first 3 force, last 3 torque; not the 7-DOF torque measurement

get_applied_joint_efforts.meaning: effort specified by set_joint_efforts; different from measured solver projected effort

apply_forces_and_torques_at_pos.meaning: applies force/torque and optional position in local or global coordinates; must determine actual application point and static simulation behavior independently

tau_J.meaning: real link-side measured joint torque sensor signals, N*m

tau_ext_hat_filtered.meaning: low-pass-filtered external joint torque estimated as error between tau_J and expected model torques; configured end-effector/load and robot mass/dynamics excluded, N*m

O_F_ext_hat_K.meaning: estimated force-then-torque at stiffness frame K, expressed in base frame O; force applied by robot to environment positive, environment on robot negative; returns zero near/in singularity; N,N*m

known_unknowns: Static file inspection finds fr3_joint1..7 and fixed fr3_joint8, but actual articulation DOF names, indices, order, effective controller settings, solver settings and timestamps require runtime measurement.
Solver projected joint effort is not yet shown equivalent to FR3 hardware tau_J or model-derived tau_ext_hat_filtered.
Action-reaction sign, effect of position-hold controller and loaded versus unloaded matching remain unverified until actual isolated paired probe.
Dynamic compensation, actuator tracking, online external torque observation and suction-contact wrench remain unvalidated.
Known applied load is an independent validation oracle, never an estimator measurement channel.
